description: The two pie charts represent the distribution of different categories related to task performance, with the left chart showing a dominant category and the right chart displaying a more varied distribution. The left chart has four slices, labeled as "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark blue, 8.0%), "Correct" (teal, 68.0%), "Reason Error" (light blue, 12.0%), and "Question Misunderstood" (gray, 12.0%), with percentage labels inside each slice. The right chart also has four slices, labeled as "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark blue, 10.0%), "Correct" (teal, 45.0% approximately, although not directly labeled), "Reason Error" (light blue, 21.0%), and "Question Misunderstood" (gray, 14.0%), with percentage labels inside three of the slices. A legend is provided above the charts, indicating the color corresponding to each category. The slices in both charts are visually distinct due to their colors, and the charts do not appear to have any exploded or offset slices. The categories are listed in a specific order in the legend, but the slices within the charts are not ordered in a particular way, except that the largest slice is placed first in the left chart.
